Book a repair or upgrade

Four short steps. We use this to plan the diagnosis, then contact you to confirm timing and how to get the device to us.

Your device
Device type

Usually on a label underneath the laptop or in system settings.

What is happening

When did it start, what happens, and any error messages you see. Do not include passwords.

Is there data on the device you cannot lose?
Contact and timing

This is a preference, not a booking. We will confirm an appointment with you.

Review and send
This form is not connected yet

You can fill it in and we will check every field, but submissions are not sent anywhere until Jemawe connects a secure form service. Nothing you type is stored.

What happens next

  1. We review the request

    and may ask a follow-up question.

  2. We confirm timing

    and how to get the device to us.

  3. Diagnosis and quote

    before any repair work begins.

What we ask for, and why

  • Only what we need to reply and understand the request.
  • Never passwords, PINs, or payment details.
  • Replies are handled during business hours, not around the clock.
